shots.subject: Demian
shots.continuity_notes: Demian is soaking wet, freezing, and re-armed with the seismic hammer.
shots.performance: Pale, lips blue, jaw clenched, teeth chattering uncontrollably. He shivers violently, his eyes darting as he struggles to focus through a lingering chemical haze. He curls inward to preserve core heat, displaying grim, punishing endurance.
shots.blocking: The camera pushes low across the wet tiles. Demian crashes into the ice-cold pool and surfaces with a ragged gasp. Fighting the shock, he deliberately dives back under the dark water. Seconds later, he breaches again, this time hauling the sunken seismic hammer. He struggles to the edge, dragging himself and the heavy metal tool onto the ceramic tiles.
shots.atmosphere: Dark, wet, and lit only by harsh, rotating emergency red strobes.

camera.angle: Low angle, water level skimming the ceramic tile floor

light.key: Rotating emergency red beacon strobe pulsing rhythmically across the dark water and wet concrete
light.practicals: Submerged emergency pool indicator LEDs casting faint cyan luminescence through murky water, pulsing red hazard sirens overhead

look.palette: Deep crimson, murky industrial cyan, wet slate grey, cold ceramic white
look.filter_grain: Subtle water droplet misting on optical glass with low-light digital grain

audio.score_cue: A stark, minimal industrial drone that drops out the chaotic jungle sounds, leaving only the harsh reality of the freezing environment.
audio.sfx: A violent, echoing splash as Demian hits the water. A sharp, ragged gasp as he breaches. The churning of water as he dives again. A dull clink of heavy metal underwater. A second breach with violent coughing. The heavy, wet slap of hands on ceramic, his uncontrollable, chattering breaths, and the harsh, grating metallic scrape of the seismic hammer being dragged onto the tiles.
audio.ambience: Cavernous, echoing acoustics of the dark, wet basement. A low, rhythmic hum from the rotating emergency red strobes.
